system_prompt: Synthetic bank-write test. Only announce recording after confirmed bank success.

readback.name: readback
readback.task_message: Read back {{amount}} dollars on {{date}} for the credit card. Ask Do you confirm?

extraction_schema.name: consent_action
extraction_schema.description: Current response to read-back: confirm ONLY an unqualified clear yes to the unchanged proposal. Any amount/date correction is correct even when preceded by yes. No is refuse. Questions, silence or unrelated speech are pending.

extraction_schema.name: corrected_amount
extraction_schema.description: New amount explicitly requested in the latest correction; omit when no amount correction. Never copy the old read-back amount.

success.name: success
success.task_message: Say the promise is recorded and You will receive a text message confirming this promise. No more bank actions in this functional check.

failed.name: failed
failed.task_message: Say I could not record your promise because the service failed. Never say it was recorded. Outcome reason for the template is service_error.
